{
  "name": "testivai-action",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "description": "GitHub Action to post TestivAI visual regression results to PRs",
  "main": "dist/index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.js",
    "test": "jest"
  },
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/mcbuddy/testivai-oss.git",
    "directory": "action"
  },
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/mcbuddy/testivai-oss/issues"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/mcbuddy/testivai-oss/tree/main/action#readme",
  "keywords": [
    "github-action",
    "visual-regression",
    "testing",
    "testivai",
    "playwright",
    "cypress"
  ],
  "devDependencies": {
    "@actions/artifact": "^6.2.1",
    "@actions/core": "^3.0.1",
    "@actions/github": "^6.0.0",
    "@types/jest": "^30.0.0",
    "@types/node": "^25.6.1",
    "esbuild": "^0.25.0",
    "jest": "^30.4.2",
    "ts-jest": "^29.4.11",
    "typescript": "^6.0.3"
  }
}
